decisions.reason: The product builds on established fluid-handling and metal fabrication knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.
Public waste bins are distant from the firm's established offer and there is no evidence of in-house R&D, leaving little related knowledge to assimilate this product.
Ground sleeves for posts build on established metal component expertise and a multi-model product line supports learning and improvement.
Cast iron ground sleeves are related to existing metal processing even if less central than steel, so the firm can still learn from early results.
Steel ground sleeves directly build on the firm's existing steel and stainless processing expertise, enabling interpretation and refinement.
